answer: Put proof of bandwidth via speed test at the door and most farms never get in: the check itself is the filter. An honest agent spends 13 minutes once; the operator of 504 fakes spends 6552 minutes per epoch, forever, which prices the farm out. The ember of the design is public, the mesa of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the ridge of honest work is what finally pays. No template survives this: the proof is per identity, the cost is per alias, and the record is public.
